recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-50017 unless the work group later wants to further polish the existing example or add additional non-patient focus examples beyond the approved IV-pump scenario.
issue_request: FHIR-50017 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by Orders and Observations. It asked to make clear that Observation.focus can be used when the subject of record is not a patient, and the approved resolution required a formal Observation example where an IV pump is the subject/device, a DeviceMetric flow rate is the focus, and a DeviceAssociation links the device to a Patient.

Follow-up commits 18c4bc5b836129404e6a0c0e2f730e779f46ac36, 2b906e8ba0a68c9c750e4a1849d96e69dbce897e, and f04b9c191ea637727687d8d5306cf076d04e12d9 corrected the example id/fullUrl/unit display and kept the nested DeviceAssociation and DeviceMetric current with later resource changes.
additional_context: FHIR-43357 is the earlier Applied/Persuasive-with-Modification issue that expanded Observation.focus commentary for device metric use cases; FHIR-50017 specifically converted that device-metric focus guidance into a concrete example. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and DeviceAssociation and DeviceMetric are active approved resource entries. OO minutes on 2025-03-25 record FHIR-50017 as persuasive with a 4-0-0 vote. Precise Zulip searches found no direct discussion of FHIR-50017 or the example ids that would change the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already contains the requested IV Pump Flow Rate Observation example Bundle: Observation.subject and Observation.device reference the IV pump Device, Observation.focus references the DeviceMetric flow-rate resource, the Bundle includes that DeviceMetric, and the Bundle includes a DeviceAssociation from the IV pump to Patient/pat1. The example is listed in list-Observation-examples.xml and linked from observation-examples-header.xml.
